title: Endless icon carousel with badge counts
summary: Five rounded app tiles glide left in an endless row at constant speed; twice a red badge pops onto one tile, counts up, then shrinks away. A seamless 10 s loop that says the product sits among the tools people use.
use_when: An integrations or ecosystem beat: the product lives next to tools the viewer knows
A seamless loop for a landing page hero, waitlist or social card
Showing activity (unread items, alerts) without any UI rebuild
A family of apps or cards presented as equals

look.type_style: small medium grotesk labels inside tiles (~1.2 % H); badge numeral medium grotesk, white on red, ~2.5 % H

structure.shot: row of rounded tiles on a dark corner gradient; red badge lands on the second tile and counts 1 to 5, then shrinks out
structure.camera: dolly: row travels left at a constant 312 px/s @1920 (10.4 px/fr), easings.linear, never stops
structure.motion: badge enters f4, springs.pop 3 fr (overshoot not measurable); digit shows 1 at f7, then steps every 3 fr to 5 at f18 (counter, no roll); holds to f54; exit scale to 0 easings.inExpo 4 fr, gone f58

structure.shot: row keeps gliding with no badge; first tile leaves left, a pale lavender wordmark tile enters right at 2.50
structure.motion: no in-row animation; one new tile crosses the right edge every 60 fr (2.00 s), spacing = 60 fr of travel

structure.shot: row keeps gliding; the deep blue card tile enters right, the white card tile leaves left
structure.motion: no in-row animation; tiles stay at full scale and opacity while crossing the frame edge (hard crop, no fade)

structure.shot: red badge lands on the lavender tile (now second in the row) and counts 1 to 2, holds, then shrinks out
structure.motion: badge enters f184, springs.pop 3 fr (overshoot not measurable); digit steps once at f190; holds to f234; exit easings.inExpo 4 fr, gone f238

structure.shot: row glides back to the opening order (blue card, logo tile, white card) so frame 300 matches frame 0
structure.motion: no in-row animation; the five-tile cycle is exactly 300 fr (5 tiles x 60 fr), seamless loop

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, accent for the badge (default red), one tile carries the brand mark
params.content.tiles: 4-6 tile specs {icon|logo, label?, bg}: the brand tile plus partner or sibling tiles
params.content.badges: list of {tile, at, to, out}: which tile gets a badge, start frame, final count, exit frame (default two badges, counts 5 and 2)
params.timing.step: frames of travel between neighbouring tiles (default 60 = 2.00 s); loop length = tiles x step
params.tileSize: tile edge as a fraction of frame width (default 0.11, gap 0.035)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; row stays vertically centred, tile count visible scales with width
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0, 1.5, 6, 7.5 s: badge enters f4/f184, digits step every 3 fr, badge exit 4 fr ending f58/f238. Travel 312 px/s @1920 (motion.json, constant every second, coherence 0.74-0.82), one tile step per 60 fr, 5 tiles = 300 fr loop. Zoom 0.05-0.77 %/s in motion.json is not visible in the sheets; treat as noise. Badge red is not in the palettegen output (too small); sample it from the brand accent. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): icon-carousel, badge-pop. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
